title: Descent of proper support in Noetherian approximation
statement: Let I be a directed set and let (S_i)_{i\in I} be an inverse system of quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms, where S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R_i) for Noetherian rings R_i, and let S=\varprojlim_i S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R). Let X_i be a finitely presented S_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme], let F_i be a finitely presented \mathcal{O}_{X_i}-module, and write X=X_i\times_{S_i}S and F for the pullback of F_i to X [def-pc-base-change]. If the support of F is proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], then there is j\geq i such that the support of the pullback of F_i to X_j=X_i\times_{S_i}S_j is proper over S_j.

source.place: Limits, Lemma 32.13.5 (Tag 081G, limits-lemma-eventually-proper-support), together with Cohomology of Schemes Lemma 30.26.7 (Tag 0CYS, coherent-lemma-module-support-proper-over-base)

proof.text: Since F_i is finitely presented it is a quasi-coherent \mathcal{O}_{X_i}-module of finite type. Let Z_i\hookrightarrow X_i be its scheme-theoretic support [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-theoretic-support], a closed subscheme with underlying set \operatorname{Supp}(F_i). For j\geq i put Z_j=Z_i\times_{S_i}S_j\hookrightarrow X_j and Z=Z_i\times_{S_i}S\hookrightarrow X, closed subschemes as base changes of a closed immersion, with underlying sets the preimages of \operatorname{Supp}(F_i) under X_j\to X_i and X\to X_i (underlying set of a base change of a closed immersion, Stacks 01JT, elementary). By [lem-weil-pbc-support-pullback-finite-type](3) these preimages are \operatorname{Supp}(F_i|_{X_j}) and \operatorname{Supp}(F); in particular these supports are closed. The morphism Z_i\to S_i is locally of finite type (closed immersion followed by the finitely presented X_i\to S_i), and Z_i, S_i are quasi-compact and quasi-separated (S_i affine, Z_i closed in X_i, which is of finite presentation over S_i).

X\to S is locally of finite type (base change of X_i\to S_i) and Z is a closed subscheme of X with underlying set \operatorname{Supp}(F), which is proper over S by hypothesis [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base-properties](1) (every closed subscheme structure on a closed subset proper over S is proper over S), Z\to S is proper.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-eventually-proper] to the inverse system (S_j)_{j\geq i} and f_0: Z_i\to Y_0=S_i (with S_i, Z_i, Y_0 quasi-compact and quasi-separated by step 1): its base change Z\to S is proper by step 2 and f_0 is locally of finite type by step 1, so there is j\geq i with Z_j\to S_j proper.

Z_j is a closed subscheme of X_j with underlying set \operatorname{Supp}(F_i|_{X_j}) (step 1), X_j\to S_j is locally of finite type, and Z_j\to S_j is proper (step 3). By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base-properties](1) (some closed subscheme structure proper suffices), the support of the pullback of F_i to X_j is proper over S_j.
